cost_bound_conditional.note: All prompt characters are ASCII. Characters are an upper bound on tokens only under the assumption that a token covers at least one character; Gemini's tokenizer was not queried (that would be an API call). I_max is therefore NOT measured.
cost_bound_conditional.basis: 8192 output tokens on every call, retries 0, prices $0.30 / $2.50 per 1M tokens read 2026-10-12
cost_bound_conditional.od10_gate: OD-10 remains in force: measure I_max with the provider tokenizer before any paid call; stop and ask the owner if the estimate exceeds US$100 or cannot be assured.

od9_check_max_output_tokens_8192.reason: The response format asks for a copy of the constraint (about 70 words), one verdict token and optional comments; with thinking_level minimal 8192 tokens is large relative to the requested content. This is a plausibility argument, not evidence that every response will be complete: SF3 handling and the pilot decide.
